minor.comment: A save conflict between two editors shows both versions, with 'Keep mine' and 'Use theirs'; a URL change names the entries that link to it and can update their links
The form checks a field when the editor leaves it and before a save; each problem in the summary moves to its field, and the problems on the Publish page link to the entry and the field

The Media view deletes a file or a selection when nothing uses it, and shows where a file is used; the picker in a form uploads into the form's own folder and offers only its files and the shared ones
A page that shows an older content model asks the editor to save and load it again; the System page names a model that cannot be read

When the session ends, the page stays and offers to sign in again; entry and settings forms keep their unsaved changes in the tab and offer to restore them after the sign-in; a warning comes five minutes before the end
Entries, settings and lists show whether a saved change is published, with Publish and Discard on the entry page; each shared media file is its own change
The editor uses editing words, not Git words; the technical details are in a closed 'Details for developers' section
The Publish page lets editors choose the changes to publish, suggests a summary ('Say what changed'), shows when each change was saved, and confirms that the website is being rebuilt

patch.comment: Fix 'Today' in the date field (local date), half-typed coordinates, the list search, the slug hint, list cells for dates, choices, rich text and media, a settings page that failed to load, and '0 entries' while the dashboard loads
The bundle ships THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt, with the license of each package in it.

minor.comment: A media field with `alt` shows an alt-text input under each image, with its own error message.

A rich-text field never opens empty and never drops Markdoc: stored text with a node that the editor cannot show (an image, a table, a `{% tag %}`, an attribute, a link title), or text that the editor refuses, opens read-only with the reason and the source. The toolbar option now limits only the buttons, so a stored heading in a field without heading buttons still loads.

none.comment: Fixes after review: code inside a link or bold loads again, an ordered list keeps its start number, a first divider is written as *** so that it never starts front matter, front matter and variables open read-only, and the toolbar also limits the typing shortcuts.
The README states that the package is internal.

minor.comment: Show a notice on a read-only collection or singleton and hide its save, delete and new buttons; show a placeholder for a field type that needs a newer Mica.

Show changes made on the website to an entry with a draft, and let editors keep their version or take the website's. Show the clone's sync state, publish the reviewed changes, and remove the database from the System page.

none.comment: Security: refuse an oversized request before reading it: 2 MiB for JSON, and at most 10 files of MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES per upload; the editor uploads in batches
Add a Content-Security-Policy to every response, and serve the editor font from the admin instead of Google Fonts
Security: refuse SVG uploads, do not list or serve SVG files, and serve every media file in a sandbox, as a download unless it is an image
Security: over https, prefix the session and CSRF cookies with __Host- and send Strict-Transport-Security; in production, refuse an http:// public URL except on loopback

patch.comment: Show the sign-in refusal message for the code that the callback sends

minor.comment: Apply the v1.5 brand: the micacms wordmark and favicon, aubergine and creme colors, and Inter as the only font.

patch.comment: The System page no longer shows a session count.
Count pending edits, not files, in the Publish badge and on the dashboard: a URL change is one edit.
Show a URL change on the Publish page as one renamed entry, with only the changed fields.

none.comment: Preserve fenced code blocks when rich-text content opens in the editor.

minor.comment: The Publish page can show what a pending change does, as a before/after comparison rather than a diff: each changed field is one row with the stored value beside the staged one, worded by the field type — Yes/No for booleans, option labels for selects, file names for media, breadcrumbs into sections. The server gained `GET /api/admin/changes/compare`, which reads the same document from the repository and from the pending workspace — HEAD versus the working tree locally, the repository versus the draft overlay when deployed.

A larger refactor. Saves now land in a draft workspace and an explicit Publish writes them to the repository as one commit — a working tree under the local connector, a draft store behind the provider connectors. The editor split into composable packages: an authentication-neutral runtime, the admin SPA as built assets, a server-only OIDC gate, and two composition roots — `@micacms/editor` (`npx`, loopback, no authentication code at all) and `@micacms/self-hosted` (Docker, behind OIDC). `MICA_MODE` is gone: the mode is which app you run. `@micacms/model` was renamed to `@micacms/core`.

none.comment: The build no longer warns about zod's Rollup-confusing comments or the admin bundle's deliberate size.

patch.comment: A saved entry no longer warns about unsaved changes when leaving. The rich text editor fires transactions that change nothing stored — normalising the parsed document on mount, and re-parsing after a save reloads the entry — and its serialization differs from the server's stored form by a trailing newline, so each of those emits marked a clean form dirty. The field now emits only when the value it would emit actually differs from the one it holds.
